resources.string: Optional, off unless you turn it on. Reads the on-screen labels of the apps that have a detector (currently YouTube Shorts) to count new clips. Labels are analysed on this device and are never stored or uploaded.

Optional, off unless you turn it on. Watches for windows of apps that have reached a limit, including picture-in-picture, and shows Brain Storm\'s blocking screen. It does not read screen text and cannot stop third-party playback.
